dict.string: Projector uses a camera (e.g. your iPhone via Continuity Camera) to show you the wall so you can align the projection and mark areas to black out.
Projector plays Apple Music through the Music app: it needs to tell Music which song to play, pause and seek, and to read your playlists.
Projector listens to the Music app's sound so the visuals and effects can move with the music it is playing.
